versions.changelog:
- Initial release of charger-cable-gate skill.
- Diagnose USB-C charging issues by evaluating charger, cable, and device compatibility.
- Explains key USB Power Delivery (PD) rules: PD versions, cable current limits, e-marker requirements, charge-only cable pitfalls, and proprietary protocol mismatches.
- Provides clear verdicts (OK, CAPPED, SLOW, NO-CHARGE) with exact bottleneck identification.
- Includes sample commands, troubleshooting steps, and practical tips for avoiding common charging traps.
